Design WSL-host <-> Entra <-> k0s-mesh participation & credential flow
tasks.description: PR #1179 (Windows-keystore credential proxy) does NOT cover this — it's a narrow single-static-secret passthrough, and is itself backlogged/superseded per #1048 in favor of a Cloudflare-DO vault approach (#1069). Real gap: the WSL dev host is Entra-authenticated in-browser only (device not Entra-managed/enrolled), and it's unclear how it should obtain/proxy short-lived Azure/Entra tokens or certs to safely join the fung1/sm3lly/b00t-node k0s mesh over Tailscale, without landing long-lived secrets on an unmanaged device. Separately confirmed: fung1 (192.168.1.0/24) cannot route to the app4dog-k0s control plane at 192.168.2.13:6443 (different subnet, not reachable via any known Tailscale peer) - likely b00t-node isn't Tailscale-joined yet or needs a subnet route advertised. Blocked pending SSH/Tailscale auth key/Entra tenant details for that host.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc covers: how WSL obtains/proxies Entra tokens without local long-lived secrets
Design doc covers: how WSL joins the Tailscale tailnet / reaches b00t-node's k0s API
Explicitly reconciles with (or supersedes) backlogged #1048 / #1069 credential-vault direction
Local WSL node stops being a build target once mesh participation works (per current goal: build on farm, not locally)
